title: Restore Rehearsal Card
user: An operator of a managed database or self-hosted service who needs a repeatable, auditable answer to whether a backup can actually restore into a usable service.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that runs declared restore steps into an isolated Docker/compose target, executes health and row-count assertions, records timings/checksums, and emits a signed Markdown card.
success_measure: A pilot completes a weekly restore rehearsal with a documented RTO and catches one intentionally broken restore step before an incident.
constraints: Use isolated networks and non-production credentials; never emit restored data in reports; support only declared safe commands and explicit destructive-target confirmation.
